# Change Text Case

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Changes the case of text.

## Syntax

~~~~text
changeCase(text: <#String (Allows Variables)#>, case: <#Enumeration (WFCaseType)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
changeCase(text: "ThE cAkE Is A LiE", case: Capitalize Every Word)
~~~~
